beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Hi! I'm your guide. Let's travel back eleven thousand years.
beats.scene: Museum hall. The monkey pops up into a close-up, waves, talks to camera, gets excited; a time vortex swallows the frame.
beats.camera: slow push in, shake on the vortex

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Ice Age is ending. Glaciers are melting, and mammoths roam the land.
beats.scene: The monkey drops out of the sky onto a snowbank, shivers, looks at the melting glacier, then a mammoth herd walks in and trumpets.
beats.camera: pan from the glacier to the herd, push in

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: People gathered berries and roots. Most were tasty. Some... not so much!
beats.scene: Ama picks berries, Tuk eats one happily. The monkey eats one, loves it; eats a second: disgust. Ama and Tuk laugh.
beats.camera: slow push in on the monkey for the gag

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Toolmakers chipped flint into razor-sharp blades. It takes practice. Ouch!
beats.scene: Oru knaps flint, flakes fly. The monkey tries, hits his thumb. Oru laughs and holds up a finished blade.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: At night, families gathered round the fire, to share food and stories.
beats.scene: Night camp. Nana tells a story with a shadow mammoth on the rock wall; Tuk is amazed; the monkey yawns by the fire. Camera rises to the stars, title.
beats.camera: slow pull back and tilt up to the stars
